title: The Choir of Vessel Farm
author: Isandro Joubert
blurb: Lena Underhill, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
